svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.american-football-helmet-profile", "profiles": ["swell-paper-v1", "index-embossed-v1", "viewplus-variable-height-v1"], "teaching": "Explore an actual unworn American-football helmet beside this right-facing shell-and-faceguard diagram. One rounded shell has an open front,one ear opening and two visible shell/guard attachment points. A crossbar joins the guard at both ends;far-side fittings are hidden. Chinstrap,vents,hardware and branding are omitted. This is a restricted object-matching draft,not fitting,protection or product certification.", "geometry_exception": "Swell/ViewPlus share1.4mm contour and limb/toe strokes and1.2mm eye points. Index uses1.2mm native graphic dots on the same logical parts with explicit3.1mm junction/spacing guards. Feet are schematically opened as documented. All alternatives in this same master;no exact source reconstruction.", "physical_evaluation": "pending", "viewplus_shading_revision": {"date": "2026-11-06", "fill": "#808080", "purpose": "Differentiate material from air: lower grey object surface, unchanged higher outline/features, and white unraised openings. Openings are not shaded as solid material.", "geometry_changed": false, "physical_testing": "pending", "human_review_of_revision": "pending"}}

g.data-exception-reason: Native1.2mm graphic dots,not Braille. Essential endpoints,roots and contacts are retained;optional interior candidates closer than3.1mm are omitted. One logical point at each joint;eye is a single isolated dot. Physical continuity remains pending.

use.data-design-purpose: Differentiate material from air: lower grey object surface, unchanged higher outline/features, and white unraised openings. Openings are not shaded as solid material.
Keep the actual opening unraised within the shaded material; existing border and internal features stay above it.
